# solution.py
def decompose(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Replace each precomposed Hangul syllable in `text` with its constituent
    compatibility jamo (initial, vowel, final if present). All other
    characters are left unchanged.
    """
    # Unicode constants for Hangul
    S_BASE = 0xAC00
    S_END = 0xD7A3
    L_COUNT = 19
    V_COUNT = 21
    T_COUNT = 28
    N_COUNT = V_COUNT * T_COUNT  # 588

    # Compatibility jamo ranges
    L_BASE = 0x3131  # ㄱ
    V_BASE = 0x3141  # ㅏ
    T_BASE = 0x3131  # ㄱ (but final consonants start at 0x3131 too)

    # Mapping from indices to compatibility jamo code points
    # Initial consonants (19)
    L_TABLE = [
        0x3131, 0x3132, 0x3134, 0x3137, 0x3138,
        0x3139, 0x3141, 0x3142, 0x3143, 0x3145,
        0x3146, 0x3147, 0x3148, 0x3149, 0x314A,
        0x314B, 0x314C, 0x314D, 0x314E
    ]
    # Vowels (21)
    V_TABLE = [
        0x3141, 0x3142, 0x3143, 0x3144, 0x3145,
        0x3146, 0x3147, 0x3148, 0x3149, 0x314A,
        0x314B, 0x314C, 0x314D, 0x314E, 0x314F,
        0x3150, 0x3151, 0x3152, 0x3153, 0x3154,
        0x3155
    ]
    # Final consonants (27, index 0 means none)
    T_TABLE = [
        0x0000, 0x3131, 0x3132, 0x3133, 0x3134,
        0x3135, 0x3136, 0x3137, 0x3138, 0x3139,
        0x313A, 0x313B, 0x313C, 0x313D, 0x313E,
        0x313F, 0x3140, 0x3141, 0x3142, 0x3143,
        0x3144, 0x3145, 0x3146, 0x3147, 0x3148,
        0x3149, 0x314A
    ]

    result = []

    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if S_BASE <= code <= S_END:
            # Decompose syllable
            s_index = code - S_BASE
            l_index = s_index // N_COUNT
            v_index = (s_index % N_COUNT) // T_COUNT
            t_index = s_index % T_COUNT

            # Append initial and vowel
            result.append(chr(L_TABLE[l_index]))
            result.append(chr(V_TABLE[v_index]))
            # Append final if present
            if t_index != 0:
                result.append(chr(T_TABLE[t_index]))
        else:
            result.append(ch)

    return ''.join(result)
